description: 丹麦弃兵 C21 — 连续弃兵换发展：极限速度与风险并存

intro.popup_en: Gambit Initiative, Lesson 3: If one pawn can buy time, what about two? The Danish Gambit is an extreme version of the idea: White offers two pawns in three moves, opening lines for the bishops. Follow the game to see what White gets in return.
intro.popup:
弃兵争先 第3课

如果一个兵换速度是合算的……
那两个兵呢？

丹麦弃兵是弃兵争先的"极限版本"：
白方连续送出两个兵！

d4→c3→b2，三步走了三个兵格
换取了什么……
跟踪这局棋来发现答案！

outro.popup_en: The double gambit opens both bishops' diagonals and can give White a lead of four or five tempi while Black's pieces remain undeveloped. But there is real risk: if Black declines the second pawn with ...Nf6 instead of ...cxb2, White's center is weakened without the same compensation. The more material you offer, the greater the compensation you must obtain.
outro.popup:
丹麦弃兵总结

连续弃兵的极限收益：
① 两象全开——Bc4+Bb2，双重斜线控制！
② 발展差距高达4-5步
③ 黑방中心兵虽多，但子力全在原位

⚠ 连续弃兵的风险：
如果黑方不接受第二个兵（走Nf6而非cxb2）
白方的中心被削弱，风险反转！

弃兵越多，补偿要求越高！

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center and opens the game.
d4! White expands in the center and challenges e5.
...exd4 captures the d4-pawn. White's pawn disappears, but this is part of the plan.
moves.popup:
exd4 黑方吃掉d4
白方d4消失……但这是计划的一部分！

moves.popup_en: c3!! White offers another pawn instead of recapturing on d4. This is the Danish Gambit's core idea: use two pawns to open two diagonals for the bishops.
moves.popup:
c3！！第一个弃兵！

白方不夺回d4——
而是再送一个兵！

这就是丹麦弃兵的核心：
用两个兵打开两条斜线！

moves.popup_en: ...dxc3 accepts the first offered pawn. Black is already a pawn up, and another pawn is available, but taking more material can cost time.
moves.popup:
dxc3 黑方吃第一个弃兵

黑方已多了一个兵……
还有第二个在等着！
贪婪是危险的……

moves.popup_en: Bc4! White develops the bishop without spending a move to recover a pawn. It targets f7 from an excellent diagonal and keeps the initiative.
moves.popup:
Bc4！白方发展象！

注意：白方一步都没有用来夺回兵
每一步都在发展和建设！

Bc4瞄准f7，象在最佳对角线上

moves.popup_en: ...cxb2 greedily accepts the second pawn. Black has won two pawns but has developed no pieces; White already has a bishop on c4.
moves.popup:
cxb2 黑方贪婪，吃第二个兵！

黑方多了两个兵……
但发展完全为零！

让我们数发展：
白方：Bc4已出
黑方：没有一枚子力出来！

moves.popup_en: Bxb2!! White develops the second bishop. The two sacrificed pawns have opened the c4-f7 diagonal and the long b2-a1-h8 diagonal. Both bishops control important lines while Black's pieces are still undeveloped.
moves.popup:
Bxb2！！第二个象飞出！

⭐ 高光时刻！

白方丢了两个兵，换来了什么？
→ Bc4控制f7对角线
→ Bb2控制a1-h8长对角线

两象全开，火力覆盖全盘！
黑方的兵在吃兵，白方的象在控制盘面……

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 is Black's first developed piece. White already has both bishops on active diagonals. The tempo count shows why White has such a large development lead, even though Black is two pawns ahead.
moves.popup:
Nf6 黑方终于出子！

现在黑方第一枚子力才发展出来
白方已经有两个象在最强位置！

节拍对比：
白方：3步（e4+d4+c3+Bc4+Bxb2=实际5步，其中2步是送兵）
黑方：1步（Nf6）
发展差距：4步！

moves.popup_en: Nc3! White develops a knight and reinforces the position.
...Nc6 develops Black's second piece, while White has already developed two bishops and a knight.
moves.popup:
Nc6 黑方第二枚子出来
但白方已经有了Bc4+Bb2+Nc3……

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White develops a third piece. White has four developed pieces to Black's two: the sacrificed pawns have bought a clear development lead.
moves.popup:
Nf3！第三枚子发展！

⭐ 发展清单对比：
白方：Bc4 + Bb2 + Nc3 + Nf3（4子）
黑方：Nf6 + Nc6（2子）

差距：白方多发展2步！
这就是两个兵买来的速度！

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4 develops the bishop and pins Nc3, trying to disrupt White's coordination.
moves.popup:
Bb4 黑方出象，别针Nc3！
试图牵制白方……

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles with four pieces developed and the king safe, ready to use the f1-rook in the attack. Black is two pawns up but the pieces are not coordinated and the king is still in the center.
moves.popup:
O-O！白方入城！

白方全线就绪：
4子发展完成 + 王安全
准备从f1车攻击中路！

黑方：多2个兵，但子力未协调，王未入城

moves.popup_en: ...O-O also secures Black's king and helps Black catch up in development.
moves.popup:
O-O 黑方也入城
追赶白方的发展步伐

moves.popup_en: e5!! White attacks at a critical moment. Black has just castled and stabilized the king, so White must use the remaining development lead now. The initiative is an asset that expires if it is not used.
moves.popup:
e5！！发动进攻！

⭐ 关键时刻：
白方的速度优势有时限——
黑方刚刚入城，稳定了！

白方必须趁黑方刚稳定就发动进攻！
这就是"争先"的含义：
速度是资产，不用就会过期！

moves.popup_en: Nd5!! The knight reaches a central outpost. Though e5 drove it from its previous square, the knight lands on d5, where it is powerful. Black is two pawns ahead, but White's active pieces and initiative remain significant. Consider how White can use the development lead next, and which file might open after e5 and Nxd5.
moves.popup:
Nd5！！马跳中心要格！

被e5驱赶后，马反而来到强格d5！
黑方手里多2个兵，但马在d5很强……

⭐ 练习思考：
白方接下来用什么好棋利用发展优势？
提示：e5+Nxd5后白方会打开哪条线路？
